name: hydo-self-improve
title_zh: 改完先跑测试和截图，才把分支交回给你的自我改造工具
tagline_zh: 想给 Hydo 加功能又怕弄坏正在用的它？在一次性工作树里改，跑测试、构建、截真图，最后只交回一个分支。
tagline_en: Add features to Hydo without breaking your running setup: edit in a throwaway worktree, verify with tests + real.
desc_en: Change Hydo itself — safely. Work in a throwaway git worktree, verify with tests, build and a real screenshot, and hand back a branch. Never edit the running app, never touch app data, never merge.
why_zh: 它把“改自己”变成隔离实验：不碰运行中的程序、不碰数据、不自动合并。验证靠真实截图而非嘴说。
why_en: Turns self-modification into an isolated experiment: never touches the live app, never merges. Verification via real screenshot.
limit_zh: 只适用于 Hydo 自身代码的修改，不碰数据迁移或配置迁移；需要本机有 git 和测试环境；产物止于分支，合并、部署。
limit_en: Only for Hydo source changes — no data/config migration. Needs local git + test env. Output stops at a branch; merge, deploy, release are on you.
title_en: Change Hydo itself: test, screenshot, hand back a branch
